content.value: A digital optical fiber communication system operating at a wavelength of 1 μm requires a maximum bit error rate of $1 0 ^ { - 9 } .$ Determine:
(i) Theoretical quantum limit at the receiver in terms of the quantum efficiency of the detector and the energy of an incident photon.
(ii) The minimum incident optical power required at the detector in order to achieve the above BER when the system is employing ideal binary signaling at 10 Mbps and assuming ideal detector.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
